goal: Add event-registration personal information guidance with event-specific profile-building questions for the current test user.

success_criteria.description: Registerable event detail pages expose a guided personal-information step that combines current user profile fields and event context into several profile-building questions.
Every registerable demonstration event has a deterministic question set for the current test user, and tests verify that no registerable event falls back to generic empty questions.
The registration UI lets the user review or skip questions locally and clearly labels that answers are staged for profile-building guidance until confirmed.
Focused tests cover at least three event types and prove the questions differ by event topic, target attendees, language preference, and missing user profile fields.
The registration documentation explains why this sprint uses deterministic demonstration question data and how a future generation provider can replace it.

out_of_scope: Adding live agent generation for registration questions in this sprint
Writing profile updates before explicit confirmation
